cohort: Hospitalized patients who gave birth at Kings County Hospital from April 10 through June 10, 2020
finding: In this predominantly Black population in Brooklyn, SARS-CoV-2 infection did not confer increased risk of adverse obstetric or neonatal outcomes, despite the prevalence of comorbidities.
mod_finding: In this study of a predominantly Black and underserved population, there was no difference in obstetric or neonatal outcomes between SARS-CoV-2 positive and negative cohorts.
